entities.title: Only the everyday subset is evaluated
entities.summary: Operations handle civil dates, year-months, times and date-times, POSIX instants, calendar, POSIX-second and SI-second amounts, and start-end intervals of dates or instants. The other 22 kinds, and other forms, validate structurally but are not evaluated.
entities.impact: A recurrence, an uncertain date, a set or any other kind gets unsupported (unsupported-operand) from every operation and from from_json; the README's Not implemented section lists recurrences, registries and the rest.

entities.title: Only the proleptic Gregorian calendar
entities.summary: Civil values in any other calendar or chronology are not evaluated.

entities.title: No leap-second table
entities.summary: Second 60 and SI seconds on the POSIX timeline need a leap-second table, which the library doesn't have.
entities.impact: Second 60 is unsupported (leap-second) in JSON, text and constructors; adding ElapsedSeconds to an instant is unsupported (needs-leap-seconds).

entities.title: Only POSIX instants given by ticks
entities.summary: Instants must be on the unix-posix timescale and written with ticks (and an optional subTick).
entities.impact: Other timescales (TAI, GPS, TT, ...) are unsupported (unsupported-operand); an instant given by coordinate is unsupported (unsupported-form).

entities.title: Results carry no manifest, loss report or assumptions
entities.summary: A UtvResult has operation, status, diagnostics and candidates only; the README lists result manifests as not implemented.
entities.impact: A result doesn't say which rule data produced it, what a conversion lost beyond its diagnostics, or what it assumed; the caller has to keep track of the Rules it passed.

relationships.description: Rules are explicit inputs, but results don't name them.

entities.title: Numbers are bounded by i128
entities.summary: Years, day counts and the parts of rationals are i128; the builders take i64 years and the typed amounts i64 components.
entities.impact: Beyond the range the JSON layer and the constructors answer unsupported (implementation-limit); a typed total operation whose result leaves the range panics.

entities.title: Zone rules are never extrapolated
entities.summary: Only zones the bundle lists, and times within its validity window, resolve; resolve also needs a day of margin on each side.
entities.impact: Other zones are unsupported (unknown-zone); other times are unsupported (outside-rule-window). The demo bundle covers New York, Paris and Reykjavik in 2026 and 2027 only.
entities.workaround: Load a rule bundle that covers the zones and years needed.

entities.title: Only the ISO 8601 extended profile
entities.summary: Text is read in the extended format of docs/everyday-api.md only.
entities.impact: Year-only text, week and ordinal dates, basic format and comma fractions are unsupported (unsupported-form); 24:00 is unsupported (end-of-day); critical or other annotations and Z[zone] are unsupported (unsupported-annotation); EDTF qualifiers and decimal period components are unsupported (unsupported-form).

entities.title: Builds only inside the repository
entities.summary: The structural schema is compiled in from ../../../schema/utv-1.0.schema.json relative to src/lib.rs, outside the package's own folder.
entities.impact: The crate can't be built from implementations/rust alone, for example as a packaged copy; it needs the repository around it.
